mapper.select: SELECT id,code,name,group_code,sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_category ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,code,name,group_code,sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_format ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,code,name,group_code,sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_tag ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT t.id,t.code,t.name,t.group_code,t.sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_tag t JOIN sr_portfolio_work_tag w ON w.tag_id=t.id WHERE w.work_id=#{workId} ORDER BY t.sort_order,t.id
SELECT id,code,name,description,sections_json FROM sr_portfolio_template ORDER BY id
SELECT id,code,name,description,sections_json FROM sr_portfolio_template WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM sr_portfolio_category WHERE code='software' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_portfolio_work WHERE featured=TRUE AND id != #{excludeId}
SELECT id,work_id,section_type,title,content,data_json,block_version,visible,sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_section WHERE work_id=#{workId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_portfolio_section SET sort_order=#{sortOrder} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,section_id,media_asset_id,caption,sort_order FROM sr_portfolio_section_media WHERE section_id=#{sectionId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
